text:
jordan: Hey docs team — my PR #4327 preview failed in CI. Linkcheck + Vale errors. Can someone help quickly? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4327 :grimacing:

ci-bot: PR preview failed: linkcheck (2 broken links), vale (1 policy: prefer-active-voice). Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4327/logs

jordan: The link failures look like anchor drift — I changed the header names in the migration guide earlier and two old anchors are still referenced from sdk-snippets.md.

maria: I can take the anchor fixes. @jordan — want me to push commits to your branch or open a tiny follow-up PR?

jordan: Please push to the branch if you can, that keeps the PR history tidy. The two broken targets are: `#vpc-private-deploy` referenced as `#vpc_private_deploy` and `#example-sdks` referenced as `#example_sdks`.

sanjay: Vale item: rule `PreferActiveVoice` is flagging a sentence in migration-guide.md: `The configuration was left intentionally flexible.` Should be `We left the configuration intentionally flexible.` Small change, but vale will block the preview until fixed or suppressed.

katie: I can help reword. If we prefer not to change voice for historical tone, we can add a one-line comment to the file to justify, but I lean toward rewording.

jordan: Ok, let's reword. Proposed replacement snippet:

```
Old: The configuration was left intentionally flexible to accommodate varied infra.
New: We left the configuration intentionally flexible to accommodate varied infra.
```

maria: Taking anchor fixes now. Will also open a commit with the Vale wording change suggested by @jordan. I'll run the docs preview locally before pushing.

docs-bot: To run preview locally: `make docs-preview` then visit http://localhost:4000/preview. For CI-like checks: `python scripts/linkcheck.py && scripts/run-vale.sh`

ci-bot: Re-run requested by @maria: queued. Expect ~6min for linkcheck + vale.

sanjay: Small FYI — if we see more passive-voice flags across the migration guide, we should batch them in one commit to reduce churn. Also consider adding a short note in the PR description about the scope of rephrasing for reviewers.

jordan: Agree. I'll update the PR description to list files that were reworded and note it's strictly voice/clarity edits. Also adding a `#merge-window` label? When can we merge once CI is green?

katie: We have a midday merge slot at 14:00 PT. If CI is green before then I'll take the merge. If not, we can queue for the next slot at 17:00 PT.

maria: Pushed anchor fixes and the Vale wording commit to the branch — branch build re-run started. Thanks for the quick replies.

ci-bot: Build completed: linkcheck OK, vale OK. Preview succeeded.

sanjay: Nice. @katie you can merge when ready — no additional approvals needed beyond docs reviewers.

jkordan: Thanks everyone, merging now. :thumbsup:

jordan: Closing thread — will reopen if anything else pops up.
